correctness.rationale: The cone semigroup has the full Hilbert basis {e,f,h_i} (Euclidean division on z). Determinants of basis triples are i and ±(j−i), and triples of h_i have zero determinant. For c>=0 support is minimized at (2,2,1); for c<0 it reduces to (2,2,t),(3,2,2n−1),(2,3,2n−1), with t=n except t=n−1 if p|n. All four have explicit strict exposing normals. When p|n the compact facet normal moves from (n−1,n−1,−1) to (n,n,−1); old normal lies on a different higher-dimensional normal cone. Independent determinant enumeration for all n=3..15 in six characteristic choices reproduces the vertices and sample lower-support functions. Infinite result follows from support proof.
